scope: Game-by-game online searches for all 220 built-in definitions on 2026-10-17. Evidence is field-specific. Unverified means the search did not establish international-character support, not that support is absent. No live game/client authentication certification. Authentication tokens, player usernames, directory names and third-party plugins have separate rules. Evidence notes retain their English source here and use compiled translations when displayed.

serverTitle.notes: Java 1.20 introduced UTF-8 server.properties. Java properties Unicode escapes also work with older Java servers. Bedrock documents server-name as text without semicolons. Client fonts and editions can differ; this does not relax Minecraft player-username rules.

joinPassword.notes: The standard Java and Bedrock server configuration has no join-password setting. Use the game's allowlist and account authentication. Password plugins have their own rules.

adminPassword.notes: Vanilla uses operator permissions rather than a separate administrator password. Java RCON has a separate password; plugin login systems are outside this record.

rconPassword.notes: Java has rcon.password; Bedrock has no built-in Java RCON endpoint. UTF-8 configuration support does not establish the character handling of every RCON client. Verify the exact server and client together.
